title.zh-CN: 更顺手的磁盘扫描结果浏览
title.en: Easier browsing of disk scan results

items.zh-CN: 修复向下滚动页面或将鼠标移入空间图时，扫描动画意外停止的问题。
items.en: Fixed scan animations unexpectedly stopping when scrolling the page or moving the pointer over the usage map.

items.zh-CN: 扫描完成后自动恢复左侧饼图、右侧简洁目录的浏览布局，继续保留当前目录、已选项目和清理篮。
items.en: Completed scans now return to a pie chart on the left and a compact folder browser on the right, preserving your current folder, selection, and cleanup basket.

items.zh-CN: 清理篮恢复在窗口底部悬浮，空篮时收起，拖入项目后展开；拖拽加入与删除动画继续保留。
items.en: The cleanup basket floats at the bottom of the window again, collapsing when empty and expanding when items are added, with drag-to-basket and deletion animations retained.

items.zh-CN: 扫描结果的目录栏保持紧凑并对齐面板右侧，改善宽窗口中的大片空白和窄窗口中的操作布局。
items.en: The compact folder browser aligns with the right edge of the results panel, reducing excess space in wide windows and improving the layout in narrow windows.
